description: BENE.BIZ Toggle Switch visual lets you filter data with a single ON/OFF switch — a fast, intuitive way to drive interactivity in your Power BI reports. Flip the switch to instantly apply filters on a chosen data field. Works best with string data types and supports multiple comma-separated values for both ON and OFF states. Looking for a clean, one-click way to control what your audience sees? The BENE.BIZ Toggle Switch delivers a compact, design-friendly control that can replace bulky slicers and complex bookmark setups — all while remaining highly customizable to match your report’s look and feel. Free features You can use the BENE.BIZ Toggle Switch for free with the following features: Unlimited data fields — Filter unlimited data fields for both ON and OFF states with a single toggle action. String data type support — Works best with string columns; enter multiple comma-separated values for ON and OFF. Extensive customization — Choose toggle shape (round or rectangle), set colors for ON/OFF, use alternative header titles for each state, and position titles above or below the switch. 💎 PRO features The PRO version of the BENE.BIZ Toggle Switch unlocks additional features, including: Advanced filter types — Use “includes”, “starts with”, and “ends with”. Multi-state toggle — Three states: ON, OFF, and NEUTRAL (no filtering), with alternative header titles for each state.…
